'''Dmitry Khovratovich''' is a Russian [[cryptographer]], currently a Lead Cryptographer for the [[Dusk Network]], researcher for the [[Ethereum Foundation]], and member of the [[International Association for Cryptologic Research]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.iacr.org/cryptodb/data/author.php?authorkey=1047|title=Dmitry Khovratovich|website=www.iacr.org|access-date=2018-10-15}}</ref>

==Biography==
Khovratovich, together with [[Alex Biryukov]], developed the [[Equihash]] [[proof-of-work]] algorithm which is currently being used as consensus mechanism for the [[Zcash]] [[cryptocurrency]], and the [[Argon2]] key derivation function, which won the [[Password Hashing Competition]] in July 2015.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://password-hashing.net/|title=Password Hashing Competition|website=password-hashing.net|language=en|access-date=2018-10-15}}</ref>
He is the publisher of several [[cryptanalysis]] papers for a number of mainstream cyphers, such as the first cryptanalytic attack on full-round [[Advanced Encryption Standard|AES-192]] and AES-256 which is faster than a [[brute-force attack]],<ref name="Biryukov 2009">{{Cite book|last1=Biryukov|first1=Alex|last2=Khovratovich|first2=Dmitry|title=Advances in Cryptology – ASIACRYPT 2009 |chapter=Related-Key Cryptanalysis of the Full AES-192 and AES-256 |series=Lecture Notes in Computer Science |date=2009-12-02|volume=5912 |url=http://dl.acm.org/citation.cfm?id=1696616.1696618|publisher=Springer-Verlag|pages=1–18|doi=10.1007/978-3-642-10366-7_1|isbn=9783642103650|s2cid=2938420 }}</ref> an attack on the [[RadioGatún]] cryptographic primitive,<ref>{{Cite book|last=Khovratovich|first=Dmitry|title=Progress in Cryptology - INDOCRYPT 2008 |date=2008-12-14|chapter-url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/221540935|volume=5365|pages=53–66|doi=10.1007/978-3-540-89754-5_5|series=Lecture Notes in Computer Science|isbn=978-3-540-89753-8|chapter=Two Attacks on RadioGatún}}</ref> and also the current best cryptanalysis on Skein,<ref name="Khovratovich 2018">{{Cite book|last1=Khovratovich|first1=Dmitry|last2=Rechberger|first2=Christian|date=2011|language=en|last3=Savelieva|first3=Alexandra|chapter=Bicliques for Preimages: Attacks on Skein-512 and the SHA-2 Family |title=Fast Software Encryption|series=Lecture Notes in Computer Science|volume=7549|pages=244–263|doi=10.1007/978-3-642-34047-5_15|isbn=978-3-642-34046-8|s2cid=32262663}}</ref> a candidate for the [[SHA-3 competition]].

In 2014, he published a research about the deanonymisation of clients in the [[Bitcoin network|Bitcoin P2P network]]<ref name="Biryukov 2014">{{Cite book|last1=Biryukov|first1=Alex|last2=Khovratovich|first2=Dmitry|last3=Pustogarov|first3=Ivan|title=Proceedings of the 2014 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security |chapter=Deanonymisation of Clients in Bitcoin P2P Network |date=2014-11-03|publisher=ACM|pages=15–29|doi=10.1145/2660267.2660379|isbn=9781450329576|arxiv=1405.7418|s2cid=207217947}}</ref>
